content: Simply stay in the center of the circle
...only the dream no longer has any control over you. Your advantage lies in awareness. Feel your strength...
Look at yourself first, and only then in the mirror
I am awareness. This is a dream. The dream does not control me.
Return your attention to the center.

Give me silence, water, hope. 
Give me struggle, iron, volcanoes.

“Why do I exist?”
“To be.”
“What can I do?”
“Anything.”

caption: I see myself and I see reality
what does my life want to become?

content: get quiet enough to feel what the Secret Self actually wants for you, and then use the imagination to inhabit that as fully as possible
Trade small agency for large agency

To be fully alive, fully human, and completely awake is to be continually thrown out of the nest. To live fully is to be always in no-man’s-land, to experience each moment as completely new and fresh. To live is to be willing to die over and over again.
The bad news is you’re falling through the air, nothing to hang on to, no parachute. The good news is there’s no ground.

This entity within each of us, not the ego, not experience, not time or circumstance or place or position, but consciousness only, the "I" divested of all accoutrements except pure sense of existence, this is the Self that contains all power, where essence is greater than the individual, greater than 10,000 individuals, for it is the supporting structure upon which all things are built, the evolving self of the universe.
